title: Attendee
description: A meeting attendee, from a template or the user's setup form. The root is closed; $defs/base is the open shape that meeting-plan extends with a hidden block.

personality.description: Map other words to this enum: impatient, defensive -> skeptical; friendly but firm -> neutral (see docs/protocol.md, Content mapping).

likely_objections.description: Absent or empty = generated before the session from role, cares_about and the goal.

knows.description: What this person has already seen.

voice_base.description: Persona whose voice and avatar this attendee borrows.
